text.11:72: She said: Oh woe is me! Shall I bear a child when I am an old woman, and this my husband is an old man? Lo! this is a strange thing!
text.26:171: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind.
text.37:135: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;
text.51:29: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
